name: Google Cloud
tagline: Alphabet's cloud: AI-first infrastructure, TPUs, Gemini, data analytics and Workspace
facts: Mumbai, Delhi regions; $15B Vizag 1 GW AI hub

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Accelerate every organisation's ability to digitally transform and reimagine its business through data and AI.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: The full-stack AI cloud: own chips, models, data platform, security and agent apps, sold as one.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Lead with Gemini and TPUs to win AI workloads, then pull in BigQuery, security and Workspace.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Only hyperscaler with in-house frontier model plus decade of TPUs; DeepMind research and Google-scale infrastructure.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Selling TPUs beyond Google Cloud (Blackstone JV), Wiz multicloud security, Gemini Enterprise agents.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Backlog is ~5 years of revenue: is Google Cloud now a TPU wholesaler with lab concentration risk?

customers.pain: Nvidia GPU scarcity and inference cost at scale
customers.why: TPU price-performance, gigawatt capacity, Gemini and Vertex tooling

customers.pain: Siloed data, slow analytics, hard to apply AI
customers.why: BigQuery plus Gemini on unified data; Agentic Data Cloud

customers.pain: Need scalable Kubernetes and low-cost AI APIs
customers.why: GKE heritage, generous credits, Gemini API pricing

customers.pain: Fragmented visibility across AWS, Azure, GCP risks
customers.why: Wiz plus Mandiant plus Security Operations across clouds

customers.pain: Want affordable productivity with built-in AI
customers.why: Gmail, Docs, Meet bundled with Gemini at lower price than Microsoft

products.name: TPUs (Ironwood)
products.desc: Seventh-gen custom AI accelerators, now sold to select external customers

products.name: Compute Engine / GKE
products.desc: VMs with Nvidia GPUs and managed Kubernetes

products.name: Cloud Storage / Spanner
products.desc: Object storage and globally distributed database

portfolio.north_star: Accelerator hours sold under paying multi-year contracts
portfolio.key_metrics: Backlog conversion, TPU utilisation, capacity online (GW), revenue per chip
portfolio.guardrails: Outage minutes, single-customer revenue concentration, delivery delays

products.name: Gemini Enterprise
products.desc: Agent platform and AI workspace for every employee

products.name: Vertex AI
products.desc: Model garden, tuning and deployment incl. Gemini, Claude

products.name: Gemini API
products.desc: Developer access to Gemini models by token

portfolio.north_star: Enterprise agents running weekly in production on Gemini
portfolio.key_metrics: Tokens processed, paid seats, agent deployments, API revenue growth
portfolio.guardrails: Hallucination incidents, data leakage, cost per token versus price

products.name: BigQuery
products.desc: Serverless data warehouse with built-in AI

products.name: Mandiant / SecOps
products.desc: Threat intelligence, incident response and SIEM

products.name: Google Workspace
products.desc: Gmail, Docs, Meet with Gemini built in

portfolio.north_star: Customers using three or more Google Cloud product families
portfolio.key_metrics: Cross-sell rate, Wiz ARR growth, Workspace paid seats, NRR
portfolio.guardrails: Wiz neutrality perception on AWS/Azure, seat churn, price-hike backlash

rows.how: Usage-based compute, storage; multi-year committed contracts
Multi-GW reserved capacity; external chip sales ramping through 2026
Per token, per agent, per seat for Gemini Enterprise
Per-user subscriptions; Wiz priced by workloads protected

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: ~$99B annualised; GCP infra and AI now the bulk; Workspace a steady, slower-growing base.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Developers and data teams adopt; CIOs sign; a few AI labs drive outsized backlog.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Margin up from 20.7% to 35.6% in a year; TPUs avoid Nvidia margin, but depreciation is rising.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Convert $514B backlog, external TPU sales, Gemini Enterprise seats, Wiz cross-sell, new regions.

bullets.label: History
bullets.text: Lost money until 2023; AI turned Google Cloud from distant third into fastest-growing hyperscaler.

friction: Smaller enterprise sales and partner network than rivals
Reputation for killing products hurts enterprise trust
Capacity constraints delay large AI deployments
Fewer regions and services than AWS in some markets
TPU software stack less familiar than Nvidia CUDA

competitors.label: AI chips
competitors.text: Nvidia, AWS Trainium, Microsoft Maia, AMD

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Only full stack: own model, own chips, data platform, security

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Backlog concentrated in few labs; capex drag if AI demand cools

news.label: Jul 2026
news.text: Q2: $24.8B, +82%; backlog $514B; Alphabet capex raised to $195-205B

news.label: Apr 2026
news.text: Next 2026: new TPUs, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform; Vizag AI hub groundbreaking

news.label: Mar 2026
news.text: Closes $32B Wiz acquisition, largest in Google history

news.label: Watch
news.text: External TPU sales ramp, margin as depreciation grows, share gains versus Azure

sources: Alphabet Q1-Q2 2026 results, Synergy Research Q2 2026, Google Cloud Next 2026, press coverage. North star/metrics are PM judgement for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
